macOS.aggregate: maximum over samples of the summed phys_footprint of the live process tree
macOS.tree: proc_listchildpids from the command's process, recursively
macOS.upperBound: sum over processes of ri_lifetime_max_phys_footprint; the root is read after exit, before it is reaped
alsoRecorded: system compressor and swap page counter deltas over the run
macOS.doubleCounting: phys_footprint excludes shared clean pages, so summing processes does not count shared libraries twice
limits: peaks shorter than the period can be missed; the kernel lifetime peak bounds that error from above
compressor counters are system-wide, so other host activity can contribute
macOS.validation: on a 768 MiB allocation: resident size equals ps RSS (783.8 MiB); footprint and lifetime peak equal /usr/bin/footprint (775 MB); a parent and child tree is summed
macOS.history: compressor and swap counter deltas were added after the shake-down and cost runs; sampling is otherwise unchanged

memoryCollector.linux: not declared; no Linux measurement exists, so Linux stays unqualified

windows.metric: PrivateWorkingSetSize from GetProcessMemoryInfo (PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX2): private pages resident in RAM
windows.aggregate: maximum over samples of the summed private working set of the live processes of the command's job
windows.tree: a Job Object assigned while the root process is suspended (CREATE_SUSPENDED); descendants inherit it and cannot break away; members are listed with JobObjectBasicProcessIdList
windows.timer: high-resolution waitable timer (CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION); the system timer resolution is not changed
windows.upperBound: PeakJobMemoryUsed: the kernel's exact peak over time of the job's summed private commit; private resident pages are committed private pages, so it bounds the sampled aggregate from above
alsoRecorded: summed working set including shared pages (RSS)
job page faults and CPU time
minimum available physical memory over the run
system page reads, pages input and pages output deltas (PDH raw counters, English names)
windows.doubleCounting: the private working set excludes shared pages, so summing processes does not count shared libraries twice
windows.differenceFromMacOS: phys_footprint also counts compressed private pages; the private working set does not. Without memory pressure both measure the same touched private memory; under pressure the Windows metric drops while private commit and the page counters rise. Windows and macOS numbers are not compared
limits: peaks shorter than the period can be missed; PeakJobMemoryUsed bounds that error from above
system page counters are system-wide, so other host activity can contribute
windows.implementation: Python 3.14.7 standard library (ctypes), kept outside the checkout

validation.single: 768 MiB touched in one process: private working set 774.1 MiB; summed working set 781.4 MiB, tasklist and .NET WorkingSet64 781.0 MiB; private commit 777.5 MiB, .NET PrivateMemorySize64 777.0 MiB
validation.tree: 512 MiB parent and 256 MiB child: 2 processes observed; summed working set 794.6 MiB, tasklist 794.6 MiB; private commit 785.1 MiB, .NET 784.9 MiB
validation.shortPeak: 512 MiB held 5 ms above a 256 MiB base: sampled private working set 602.9 MiB, kernel upper bound 777.7 MiB
validation.intervals: median 50.23 ms, 95th percentile 50.56 ms, maximum 50.78 ms

windows.selfCost: 0.516 s of collector CPU over 20.4 s and 401 samples (1.3 ms per sample, 2.5% of one of 24 logical processors) with one live process, measured before the sampling-off revision; the sampling path is unchanged
